alerts.title: Hypothyroidism Uncontrolled with Possible Adherence Gap
alerts.message: Patient on levothyroxine 50 mcg has TSH 12.4 mIU/L (target below 4.5) with low free T4, indicating inadequate thyroid replacement. Patient reports often forgetting the thyroid tablet, which is a likely contributor to poor control. Hypothyroidism itself can explain weight gain, tiredness, cold intolerance, constipation, dry skin, periorbital puffiness and delayed ankle reflex relaxation, so these symptoms are not attributable to DTG. The guideline excerpts do not provide levothyroxine dosing thresholds, so dose adjustment should follow standard thyroid management.

evidence.recommended_action: Address levothyroxine adherence and review the dose against TSH and free T4 per standard hypothyroidism management. Recheck TSH and free T4 after an adjustment interval.

alerts.title: Proposed DTG Switch for Weight Gain Lacks Attribution Support
alerts.message: Guidelines state that the association between integrase inhibitors and weight gain does not appear causal, and that DTG is first-line for women of reproductive age. Patient's weight gain coincides with untreated or inadequately treated hypothyroidism, which is a more plausible explanation. Switching ART for weight gain may therefore not address the cause and would risk regimen change without benefit. Note that BMI 33 and fasting glucose 5.6 mmol/L with weight gain also warrant hyperglycaemia risk screening under DTG.

evidence.recommended_action: Reconsider switching DTG; first optimise thyroid replacement and adherence, then reassess weight. Screen for hyperglycaemia risk factors given BMI ≥25 and reassess after thyroid correction.

alerts.title: Viral Load Monitoring Due on DTG-Based ART
alerts.message: Patient on TDF/3TC/DTG has last viral load <50 copies/mL on 2025-11-10, 106 days before this visit. Guidelines recommend viral load checks every 6 months on DTG-based first-line ART, and 12-monthly testing is only permitted after sustained suppression with reliable adherence. Given reported adherence lapses with the thyroid tablet, adherence should be considered when deciding monitoring intensity.

evidence.recommended_action: Plan next viral load within the 6-monthly schedule; reinforce adherence support given reported missed doses.
